breakdown.description: Boundary section contains incompatible boundary condition types (e.g., periodic vs Dirichlet/Neumann).
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained contradictory boundary conditions: Dirichlet on the entire boundary and also periodic. The ground truth removes the periodic condition. The generated specification correctly omits the contradictory periodic condition and only states to 'Apply Dirichlet boundary conditions, u = 0, on the entire boundary of the domain.', which aligns with the ground truth.
